provenance: Original Cinderfen control cages and finite construction placements; Sunmeadow finishing/export utilities are reused with attribution, never its geometry or textures.

fen_basalt.description: Split basalt with three retained fracture ridges, uneven dressed shoulders and a closed bearing shell.

lod2.description: Explicit distant basalt retopology keeps complete bearing faces and course height, with a small hewn lower corner; it does not skip structural silhouette corners.

fen_basalt_cleft.description: Individually drawn cleft basalt cleavage and fitted bearing shoulders.

lod2.description: Explicit distant basalt retopology keeps complete bearing faces and course height, with a small hewn lower corner; it does not skip structural silhouette corners.

fen_basalt_shelf.description: Individually drawn shelf basalt cleavage and fitted bearing shoulders.

lod2.description: Explicit distant basalt retopology keeps complete bearing faces and course height, with a small hewn lower corner; it does not skip structural silhouette corners.

fen_basalt_riven.description: Individually drawn riven basalt cleavage and fitted bearing shoulders.

lod2.description: Explicit distant basalt retopology keeps complete bearing faces and course height, with a small hewn lower corner; it does not skip structural silhouette corners.

fen_basalt_dressed.description: Individually drawn dressed basalt cleavage and fitted bearing shoulders.

lod2.description: Explicit distant basalt retopology keeps complete bearing faces and course height, with a small hewn lower corner; it does not skip structural silhouette corners.

ash_mortar_bedding.description: Thin packed volcanic-ash bedding behind the dressed faces; a fitted perimeter fills exposed stone joints without changing the structural opening.

basalt_footing.description: Battered eight-faced basalt footing, broad uneven mud bearing and dressed alder socket crown.

alder_pile.description: Hand-hewn alder pile with a subtle grown sweep, splayed lower bearing and reduced tenon at the crown.

scarf_tie.description: Fitted scarf tie with shouldered end housings and a slightly hewn upper arris.

swept_knee.description: Curved grown-alder knee with tapered haunch and housed crown, carrying the roof load into the bent.

fen_deck_plank.description: Thick adzed deck board with hewn long edges, eased end grain and localized threshold wear.

lod2.description: Explicit distant deck retopology: small adzed corner shoulders retain the fitted bearing envelope without enlarging drainage gaps.

reed_wall_panel.description: Bound reed wall infill with bowed weave, trimmed shoulder edges and separate real thickness.

lod2.description: Explicit retained distant boundary of reed_wall_panel

alder_cladding_board.description: Individually adzed alder cladding board, with uneven long grain shoulders, trimmed end grain and a bowed exposed face.

vault_board.description: Original cambered roof stave section; paired curved boundaries retain actual underside thickness.

reed_roof_bundle.description: Dense laid reed bundle with a comb-cut drip edge, bound upper head and substantial overlapping thatch thickness.

lod2.description: Explicit retained distant boundary of reed_roof_bundle

vault_iron_rib.description: Forged segmented roof binding following the original cambered profile, with a narrow raised shoulder.

cut_reed_tip.description: Bent cut marsh reed with an uneven lip, thick organic rim and recessed hollow pith; original literal plant fragment for exposed thatch ends.

reed_gable.description: Cambered gable infill cut to the actual barrel roof profile, separately bound at the verge.

ceramic_weather_cap.description: Open-underneath fired clay weather cap with broad rolled lips and a shallow flattened crown.

eave_trough.description: Folded rain trough with an open water channel and turned drip lips, rather than a solid eave rail.

hinge_strap.description: Blackened forged strap: flared bearing heel, slender worked shank and chisel-point terminal.

driven_pin.description: Uneven upset pin head with a driven back shank; placed individually at structural fixings.

vent_cowl.description: Curved rain-sheltered vent hood; open throat and thick rolled ceramic mouth.

louver_slat.description: Canted vent lath with adzed shoulders and a small drainage crown.

fortified_stave.description: Full-thickness reinforced gate stave with shouldered crown and a hand-hewn bowed face.

gate_arch.description: Full-depth low cambered basalt vault: six-metre ram passage, 4.8m side clearance and 5.7m crown below the defense platform.

palisade_shield.description: Broad defensive alder crest with a split angled crown and a reinforced lower shoulder.

pintle.description: Upset forged pintle, with a retained bearing shoulder and shouldered driving foot.

step_tread.description: Heavy stair tread with eased drainage nosing and uneven adzed rear bearing.

lod2.description: Explicit retained distant boundary of step_tread

vault_face_stone.description: Dressed cambered-vault face stone, slightly wider at the outer bearing and with chipped keyed shoulders.

supply_tally_cloth.description: Weighted supply tally cloth with hand-cut split hem and a shallow wind fold; original regional signal, no borrowed insignia.
